## History

Evans is an attendee at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) benefit concert whose melancholic appearance suggests she was dreadfully unhappy at some point in her past. During the event, she observes the various recitations and musical performances given by the evening's entertainment. She watches as [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) overcomes initial stage fright to deliver a celebrated recitation and a subsequent encore.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII.
